_comment: Priority scoring keyword lists for CampusPulse rule-based triage engine.
_note: Edit this file to add/remove keywords without touching priority.py. Each keyword maps to a human-readable reason string shown in the explainability panel.

category_baselines._comment: Base urgency score per complaint category. Format: [score, reason]
Infrastructure: Infrastructure and maintenance issues carry physical & safety implications
Technical: Technical disruptions impact labs, connectivity, and digital learning
Academic: Academic disruptions impact coursework, evaluations, and grading
Finance: Financial discrepancies impact registrations and administrative clearance
Electricity and Infrastructure: Electrical/infrastructure issues carry higher physical & safety risks
Water and Sanitation: Water supply & hygiene concerns directly impact student health
Hostel and Accommodation: Living condition issues affect daily student welfare and rest
Academics and Administration: Administrative blockages may disrupt exams or course registration
Internet and Wi-Fi: Connectivity disruptions impact study routines and submissions
Other: General inquiry or uncategorized operational issue

safety_keywords._comment: Physical safety / hazard keywords. Match triggers +30 priority points.
safety_keywords.food poisoning: Food poisoning or severe health illness

academic_urgency_keywords._comment: Academic deadline / constraint keywords. Match triggers +15 priority points.

operational_urgency_keywords._comment: Complainant urgency markers. Match triggers +10 priority points (if no safety match).
operational_urgency_keywords.asap: Requested resolution as soon as possible
